heading: What the C Rete implements
text:
### What the C Rete implements [IRET.2.1]

Derived from [RLOW]: every Rete feature the
compiler can emit must be supported:

| DS feature | Rete mechanism |
|---|---|
| Schema / slot types | Schema descriptors, typed value arrays of the kinds [IRET.3.1] lists |
| Simple pattern (`Schema s`) | Alpha node, all-slots bind |
| Inline equality constraint (`where slot == literal`) | Alpha test: slot == literal |
| Regex constraint (`where slot ~ /…/`) | Alpha test: regex match on slot |
| Where clause | Test CE: beta-level predicate over bound variables |
| `no Schema` (negation) | NOT node in beta network |
| `within <dur>` | Test CE over the monotonic sample minus the fact's `assert_ns` ([IRET.4.3]) |
| `then ... within` (sequence) | Multi-pattern join + test CE on ts ordering |
| `latest` modifier | NOT sub-pattern excluding older anchors |
| Refraction | Per-rule refraction table keyed by token identity (hash pre-filter + fact-id tuple, [IRET.11.3]) |
| `emit X` (plain) | RHS assert action |
| `emit X logical` | RHS assert action + TMS registration |
| `let` pure | Inlined at compile time; no Rete mechanism needed |
| `let` sync-impure (`now()`, `monotonic_ns()`) | Bind-once in RHS expression context |
| `let` async | Desugared to request + response rules; no Rete primitive |
| Cooldown gate | The terminal's `fire_guard`, or a call site's gate, calling `FN_RATE_ALLOW` ([IRET.10.4]) |
| Action verbs (log, call, publish, cache) | RHS expression nodes → builtin dispatch |
| Series aggregation in where clause | Test CE calling the `FN_SERIES_*` builtins ([IRET.13.2]) |
| `$ClockTick` | Schema with no slots; assert/retract drives time-bound tests |
| String interpolation | one `InterpExpr` node: a linear sequence of `FormatPrim`s — literal text, a value under a numeric or string spec, a time field (RLOW.6.4) |
| Json path access | `json_path` expression node → builtin |
| Truth maintenance (logical facts) | TMS: refcount + dependency table |
| TTL fact expiry | Deadline in fact; swept once per pump, before anything fires ([IRET.19.3]) |
| No-op reassertion suppression | Slot equality check (with per-slot tolerance) at assert time |
| `scope activation` facts (LSCP.2.4) | Schema descriptor with `DS_RETE_SCOPE_ACTIVATION`; lifetime tied to the firing activation |
| `scope logical ambient` facts (LSCP.2.5) | Schema descriptor with `DS_RETE_SCOPE_AMBIENT`; plain working memory with ambient-write restriction enforced at compile time |
